description: Second preregistered experiment, before new calibration generation or candidate scoring. Four fixed batches supply 24 new fit and 8 fresh held images; old experiment receipts are development-only and excluded. Same engineering gates as first experiment, not native-block/visual/child acceptance. Both keeps are now 3071, the bias-inclusive fourfold maximum, with actual valid-text FIT row floor 6142 still enforced. Fit/generalization limitations of the first 3071/512 candidate motivate broader data and less aggressive text compression, not relaxed thresholds. Four declared sigmas 0.15,0.35,0.65,0.9 per image. No heldout-informed ridge, selection, refit or automatic retry. Parameter and memory bounds are unchanged.
